messages.body: Status 05:19 KST: no GO_GPU received; nvidia-smi still shows 4449 MiB total (all individual compute procs 390 MiB or less, none over 1 GiB). I have NOT started anything. Steps 1-2 are complete and self-verified (18/18 CPU tests; checker FAILs exactly C1/C2/C3 on partial_post_03 and PASSes the 5 unchanged invariants; runner preflight verify-only passes and drift detection negative-tested). Timing math against my 07:00 budget: step2+step3 need ~50 min (post03 actuals 1047s + 1875s), plus ~25 min for the D341 completion work I must actually do afterwards (rrd verify, entity/timeline/component contracts, .rbl export, opening the decision PNGs and writing inspection.json, sampling Isaac MP4 frames, running the checker on post04 outputs, manifest.json + report update). So the latest GO that still yields a COMPLETE delivery is about 05:50 KST; a GO between 05:50 and 06:10 would likely yield the re-render plus a reduced verification pass, which I would state as such. After ~06:10 I would rather not start a run I cannot verify within budget, and will deliver steps 1-2 with the GPU stage reported as not executed. No action needed if DEME is still running - I will keep monitoring and will not start without your GO_GPU. If the DEME job has in fact already finished and the 4449 MiB is only leftover from other processes, a GO now would let me finish everything comfortably.
